source_law.text: The operator of a bus, other than a tour bus, shall: Enter a bus stop, bus stand, passenger loading zone or origin or destination point on a public street in such a manner that the bus when stopped to load or unload passengers or baggage shall be in a position with the right-hand front wheel of such vehicle not farther than eighteen inches from the curb and the bus approximately parallel to the curb so as not to unduly impede the movement of other vehicular traffic.

witness_branches: Other traffic during entry and stopped loading

requirement_dispositions.branch: Other traffic during entry and stopped loading
requirement_dispositions.evidence_or_gap: The frozen witness is stopped loading with following traffic. Three requested wheel gaps (0.30, exact 0.4572, 0.70 m) are below, at and above the statute's 18-inch value. Source-measured wheel contact, curb face, stopped loading and heading are retained; no legal verdict is inferred from a fixture.

The phrase "other than a tour bus" excludes tour buses. The selected witness fixes a non-tour bus, supported by the independent bus-classification.json and bus-zone-review.json source hashes. A tour bus is outside this selected statutory scope; the original classification remains source gated.

The "so as not to unduly impede" phrase remains part of the selected obligation. Each case records a distinct following vehicle, speed and delay across the full joined trace; the fixed traffic policy allows the wheel-gap contrast. No numerical undue-impedance cutoff exists in the text, so original traffic and pixels require independent judgment.

The location nouns are a disjunction in the activation clause. This frozen selected witness uses a source-reviewed bus stop on a public street; that one qualifying location satisfies the activation mode for each selected case. Bus stand, passenger loading zone, origin and destination are not claimed executed or legally equivalent and require separate source review if selected as their own witness elsewhere in the batch.
